# Tranya

> > Tranya is a wearable audio and fitness technology brand offering premium true wireless earbuds and smartwatches with advanced features like SonicMax audio, Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and comprehensive health tracking.

Tranya specializes in consumer electronics including true wireless earbuds and smartwatches designed for fitness, gaming, and daily use. The product lineup features proprietary SonicMax audio technology, multi-sport tracking capabilities, and seamless Bluetooth connectivity across various price points and use cases.

## Key Topics

- SonicMax Audio Technology
- True Wireless Earbuds
- Smartwatch & Fitness Tracker
- Bluetooth 5.3 Connectivity
- Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
- Gaming Mode
- Health Monitoring
- Sleep Tracking
- Sports Modes
- Water Resistance
- Wireless Charging
- Qualcomm QCC3040 SoC
- aptX Codec
- Dual Device Connection
- AI Voice Assistant

## Earbuds Collection

- [True Wireless Earbuds](https://tranya.com/collections/earbuds): Tranya earbuds collection featuring M20, T6 with Bluetooth 5.3
- [Tranya M20](https://tranya.com/products/m20): Tranya M20 earbuds: Bluetooth 5.3, game mode, SonicMax, 4 mics
- [Tranya T6](https://tranya.com/products/t6): Tranya T6 earbuds with Qualcomm QCC3040, aptX, Bluetooth 5.2
- [Tranya Nova Lite](https://tranya.com/products/novalite): Tranya Nova Lite with ANC, SonicMax, transparency mode, dual device
- [Tranya T10 Pro](https://tranya.com/products/t10-pro): Tranya T10 Pro earbuds with wireless charging, gaming mode, IPX7
- [Tranya F4](https://tranya.com/products/f4): Tranya F4 semi-in-ear gaming earbuds with low-latency, IPX5 rated
- [Tranya F1](https://tranya.com/products/f1): Tranya F1 earbuds with powerful bass, wireless charging, LED display
